description: DET, 2005 June regular phase: 49 of 49 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 49 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 49 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20240719131950: 49 listed, 49 matched to MLB's picks by name (3 by surname in the same round: #960 MLB "Christopher Torres" / "Chris Torres"; #1257 MLB "Benjamin Rodewald" / "Ben Rodewald"; #1402 MLB "Albert Gonzalez" / "Alberto Gonzalez")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
